_comment: Failure classes for tests/prove_task.py --unit 173_taskgroup_cancel. ref.py is also the validator's embedded oracle; build.py regenerates evals/tasks/173_taskgroup_cancel.json from harness.py + ref.py + validator_main.py. Equivalence was checked against CPython 3.13's asyncio.TaskGroup on every scenario that uses neither timeout nor cancel() (0 differences); CPython 3.12's TaskGroup differs on ~13% of them (its uncancel ordering), which is the intended discrimination. The oracle itself runs in the validator's interpreter (3.12 on the Sparks): since review 1116 ref.py absorbs its own undelivered parent.cancel() before uncancel() (3.12's uncancel leaves it pending, 3.13's clears it), and harness.N_TAIL cancel-tail scenarios (a body that ends at g.cancel() or raises right after it) pin that; the oracle's results are identical on CPython 3.11.10, 3.12.7 and 3.13.1 on those, and unchanged on the 600 random ones.
